Photos.Caption: prime NY strip, reverse sear method

Results.ReviewText: After nearly 20 years in the heat and rain of FL, my old Weber kettle finally died from some rust. So of course I bought a new one. I also have a Weber Genesis s435 gas grill but mostly use my charcoal grill, especially for "important" stuff like prime NY strips.  Recommend reverse sear method for steaks and ALWAYS use the starter chimney. I have sometimes put the grate right on top of the starter chimney, which really makes it like looking into the business end of a jet engine. 2 minutes on each side after bringing internal temp to 115 F. Perfect medium rare steak! Have also made low and slow pork shoulder, brisket and even and spatchcocked Thanksgiving turkey on my Weber kettle.
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: Good intro grill. Wish i had gotten the premium. Most likely I'll try to wait till next year to purchase it. Would be great if there was a way to upgrade the grill instead of having to buy a whole new one but it is what it is.
Results.Title: Beginners grill. Will upgrade to premium.

Results.ReviewText: The 22' grill takes longer to heat up and is a lot hotter than the 18" grill. It melted the handle on the chimney I was using to start the coals. Decided to go back to my 18" grill. I will use the 22" grill only when I have a party because I can place more food on it.
Results.Title: 18" vs. 22" Kettle

Results.ReviewText: I got to say i just love my weber bbq , my only problem is i would have liked the cover to be on hinges  and not just a cover . The cover is heavy  and where do i lay it once i check on my food  . That is it other then that i love it . Its of great quality !  Tx
Results.Title: Barbarqueing with a charcoal weber bbq

Results.ReviewText: Couldn’t get hot enough to cook ribeyes fast enough, not able to raise charcoal or lower grate to make heat closer to steaks for fast hot cooking! Not sure what to do with this grill, I wish I had my money back!
Results.Title: Not sold on this one!

Results.ReviewText: I bought it as a backup. This is my # 5 I have two 26 1 master chef 22 and 1 premium original kettle and now this one. Besides that they are great grills the customer service is 5 plus stars too.
Results.Title: Excellent product

Results.ReviewText: Had a bit of a setback when I assembled the grill and found the lid with the riveted on top vent was not fully flush with the grill lid. I contacted customer support and they sent me a new vent with a bolt to replace the factory rivet, but the new vent didn't fit much better. I had to modify the new vent by slowly making it cup like a upside down bowl then it finally fit snug all the way around the lid. poor quality I say for someone that's been building these since 1940 or something like that. Crazy I say. but after I fixed that issue it's been a great grill that I primarily use to rotisserie Meats.
Results.Title: You wanted it, you got it

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been using this style of grill all my whole life.  My dad is on his second one and I inherited the first. I thought i was going  to finally retire that old one when I bought this new grill. However, now I sometimes use them both when I have a lot of family to cook for. There isn’t a lot to them. They work well and last. You may have to change the grate every free years and the one touch damper will eventually corrode after about
Results.Title: Simple design and good quality.

Results.ReviewText: The grill is overall a great grill for the price, one of the classic grills to purchase. the materials are high quality and it is light enough to carry when needed. The reason I give it 4 starts is due to the clips holding the pan up being a slight hassle to manipulate and the grill cover could benefit from a second velcro anchoring strap, as I already had the wind undress the grill once and the rain filled it with water.

Results.ReviewText: Classic grill I remember my dad using when I was a kid. Well designed and sturdy yet simple and easy to set up and use. Great overall grill for cooking and smoking.
Results.Title: Classic, simple, effective

Results.ReviewText: Nothing cooks like a Weber Kettle Grill. Flavors and tastes are out of this world!
Results.Title: Taste this.

Results.ReviewText: I love these kettle grills.  I have been grilling on my mom's Weber for years and finally bought one for myself when the price dropped to $99.  I learned how to use a kettle grill properly about 30 years ago.  Since then, it has been my favorite way to grill.  I like how convenient my propane grill is, but I could not replicate the taste of smokey charcoal with gas.  Also, the gas grill just didn't get hot enough for me.  My friend has a BG egg, which works great, but it is so big and heavy, it's basically a fixture on the patio.  I can take the Weber to the beach house easily!
Results.Title: My favorite way to grill!

Results.ReviewText: I had my last weber kettle grill for decades.  I was pleasantly surprised by the new improvements (to me): hand guard to protect the handle, a button to hold the legs in, larger air holes, and the one-touch lever.  I'm hoping to get just as long of a run out of this weber.
Results.Title: Long live the weber kettle grill

Results.ReviewText: I would’ve given the grill a five star, but there is a design flow on the rack that holds the coal. The rack that holds the cold should be a solid rack, not a grill type when coals began to burn and get small. They fall through the rack and burn down in the bottom of the grill. I love the grill and the size but a better rack that the coals burn on needs to be a different design.
Results.Title: Grill Master

Results.ReviewText: Its been a long time since I've owned a charcoal grill. I regret not buying this grill sooner.
Results.Title: Don't wait

Results.ReviewText: We love the Weber Original Charcoal grill.  We use it almost everyday when the weather is nice!
Results.Title: Love Weber Original Charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Always consistent quality, that’s why you’re still producing them. The General statement is, if it isn’t broken, don’t fix it.
Results.Title: Quality

Results.ReviewText: I use my weber as an indirect smoker.  Love them for this purpose.
Results.Title: Great smoker

Results.ReviewText:
Had the 22" and 18" back in the late 80's up into the 90's and loved them, just like this new 22".
Really like the lower vent/ash remover, only 2 thing's I'd change is a stop for the closed position and a decent thermometer but those are a very minor issue.
After years of not using a Kettle Grill my first time with the new grill was like I never quit using one, it's easy to control the heat and cooks evenly throughout the entire cooking grate.
Assembly was super easy with clear easy to understand directions.
Buying another 22" this fall when they go on sale and storing it for when this one wears out in 20 years
Results.Title: Best of the Best

Results.ReviewText: I replaced my original 22 inch Weber charcoal grill with this new one. I’m hoping it will be as good as my old one….it lasted over 25 years. Through the years, I had to replace parts, like the grill racks and the bottom vent devices. It survived outside all those years, sometimes covered sometimes not, because I used it in the winter months too. Weber makes a great grill!

Results.ReviewText: Weber is always good for the great flavor and smoke combination needed for a burger or steak.
Results.Title: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: If you are looking for a charcoal grill it would be hard to find a more versatile one than this at a competitive price. Anything from low and slow all-day long cooks, like smoking a pork butt, to hot and fast 10 minute cooks, like hamburger and hot dogs this grill can do it all. This is my first charcoal grill, and I have found it very easy to learn on. It is very easy to maintain the amount of heat you want and the grill is large enough to set up multiple grilling areas. Everything that I have cooked on it so far has turned out great, with amazing flavor and plenty of moisture. The warranty that the grill comes with is amazing, it’s proof that the company stands behind their product and believes in making a quality product that will last. If you are looking at stepping into the world of charcoal grilling it is worth investing a little more money in this grill than a cheaper charcoal grill.
Results.Title: An iconic classic for a reason.

Results.ReviewText: This a great grill. Back to basics bbq. It takes some trial and error to master. The build quality is great. The accessories available are endless. It’s light enough to cart around, but not flimsy. I should have bought one a long time ago.
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Good overall. Becareful with the top vent once the grill is hit. Use thongs or something.  Also there are a few accesories that might make your grill better. Hook for lid and left or right table top with hooks.

Results.ReviewText: I have owned Weber grills for a long time . I moved and ended up not having my Weber grill . I bought a competitors grill to save a few bucks . Needless to say, I ended up returning it and getting a Webber you just can’t beat that quality. The old saying is true  you get what you pay for. Weber for life !!!
Results.Title: Buy Weber or other brand !!!

Results.ReviewText: Very easy to assemble and grilled really evenly, very affordable for people like myself on a fixed budget.
Results.Title: Basic but great grill!!

Results.ReviewText: This is one of my bithrday presents for my 70th birthday. This is also my fourth Weber 22" grill. I have cooked on my Weber grills almost every night for 50 years. I have literally worn out three other grills over the years. This all started when I was in college and I was the night and weekend manager at the largest Walgreens on the west coast. Every weekend, Weber would send out a demonstrator and he or she would cook a full turkey in front of the store. I learned quickly. My Weber grill is one of the most important cooking tools I own. When you cook on a Weber you will never want to cook on a gas grill again. Turkeys alone, over the years I have cooked hundreds.
Results.Title: Weber 22" grill. The best!

Results.ReviewText: Perfect grill for my wife and I.  We had a Weber years ago and forgot how much we liked it. Simple grilling, even heating, easy to clean, easy to store, and I believe cooking over charcoal adds a much missed flavor to whatever we’re grilling.
Results.Title: Perfect for us

Results.ReviewText: This grill is my new favorite thing!!! It is the best grill I've ever owned.
Results.Title: My Weber, My Love

Results.ReviewText: Great charcoal grill that we use on weekends after golf.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I had one back in the 80’s.  Unfortunately I got caught up in the microwave, “gotta have it now” culture, gave it away and got a gas grill.  It finally dawned me that gas just doesn’t compare to the grilling quality of charcoal.  Not to mention having to replace expensive parts over the years.  I can pre-smoke my ribs and finish them perfectly.  Glad to be back at the tried and true experience of basic BBQ.  I set it up with a custom, recycled Redwood grilling station.
Results.Title: Ultimate Grill of grills

Results.ReviewText: First one lasted over 10 years and I’m sure this one will also.  Live using it with my Weber rotisserie attachment.
Results.Title: Love it and love the price. Does everything I need

Results.ReviewText: Its all you could ask for , easy and simple to use and clean .
Results.Title: More Bang for your buck

Results.ReviewText: After several years of buying a new grill every summer, i finally decided to spring for a name brand one and grabbed this weber. I quickly discovered why these have been around for such a long time. You can really feel the quality in the materials when putting it all together. I know that unlike other sub $200 grills, this one wont peel and rust after a month of using it. I will never buy a different brand again.
Results.Title: Found my grill brand.
